DeepCool LE500 (L500 Series) 240mm Liquid Cooler

​The DeepCool LE500 (often referred to as the L500 series in certain regions) is an all-in-one (AIO) liquid cooler focused on reliable performance and a clean aesthetic. It is widely known for featuring DeepCool’s patented "Anti-Leak" technology.

​General Specifications

  • ​Cooler Type: All-In-One (AIO) Liquid Cooler
  • ​Radiator Size: 240 mm
  • ​TDP Support: Up to 220W
  • ​Socket Compatibility:
    • ​Intel: LGA 1851 / 1700 / 1200 / 115x
    • ​AMD: AM5 / AM4

​Pump & Block Details

  • ​Pump Speed: 2400 RPM (±10%)
  • ​Pump Noise: 17.8 dB(A)
  • ​Pump Connector: 3-Pin
  • ​Cold Plate Material: Copper
  • ​Special Feature: Anti-Leak Technology (Internal pressure regulation system to prevent coolant leaks caused by heat expansion).
  • ​Visuals: Static LED lighting (typically 6-color spectrum or solid green/white depending on the specific L500 variant).

​Radiator & Fans

  • ​Radiator Material: Aluminum
  • ​Radiator Dimensions: 282 x 120 x 27 mm
  • ​Fan Model: 2x 120mm PWM Fans
  • ​Fan Speed: 500 ~ 2250 RPM (±10%)
  • ​Airflow: Max 85.85 CFM
  • ​Static Pressure: Max 3.27 mmAq
  • ​Noise Level: ≤ 32.9 dB(A)
  • ​Bearing Type: Hydro Bearing

​Physical Dimensions

  • ​Tube Length: 410 mm (Flexible reinforced rubber tubing)
  • ​Pump Dimensions: 91 x 80 x 52 mm

​Key Highlights

  • ​High Performance Fans: The fans included with the LE500 offer higher-than-average static pressure, making them excellent for pushing air through the radiator fins.
  • ​Low Profile Pump: Designed with a lower height to ensure compatibility with various motherboard layouts and small cases.
  • ​Reliability: The Anti-Leak system significantly increases the long-term safety of the unit compared to budget AIOs without pressure relief valves.
  • ​Simplified Aesthetics: Clean, minimalist look with a focus on consistent lighting rather than complex ARGB patterns.
